d:
Film: Nagin
Kalakar: Rekha & Sunil Dutt
Gayak: Asha Bhosle & Mohammed Rafi
“tere ishk ka mujh pe huaa ye asar hai” 70 ke dashak ka ek behad khubsurat aur dil ko chhu lene vala romantik git hai. aasha bhosle aur mohammad rafi ki jaduee aavaz is gane ko aaj bhi evergreen banati hai.
Rekha aur sunil datt ki shandar kemistri is gane ko aur bhi yadgar banati hai.
Agar aapko purane bolivud romantik gane pasand hain, to yah gana aapki plelist men zarur hona chahie
